title: Cache Operations
description: Operator incident view with merged cache diagnostics for the LOCAL cache test stack. LOCAL synthetic test traffic only, combined across every LOCAL acceptance run in the selected window (not one acceptance run, not production). Every counter is rated per series before summing; current-value series are kept only while their own scrape target reports up == 1. Absent data means unknown or not exercised, never a healthy zero.

panels.title: Client RPS
panels.description: Completed external client requests per second over the last 1m, including non-cacheable, non-cache and failed requests. Excludes authenticated internal cache replays and requests explicitly marked by healthcheck().

defaults.noValue: No data: no live traffic in the last 1m

targets.expr: sum(rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",key="client.requests"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: skipper_cache_result_total result=hit as a share of hit+miss+stale over the last 1m.

defaults.noValue: No data: no cache results in the last 1m

targets.expr: sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",result="hit"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",result=~"hit|miss|stale"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)

panels.title: Cache miss ratio
panels.description: skipper_cache_result_total result=miss as a share of hit+miss+stale over the last 1m.

defaults.noValue: No data: no cache results in the last 1m

targets.expr: sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",result="miss"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",result=~"hit|miss|stale"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)

panels.title: Cache stale ratio
panels.description: skipper_cache_result_total result=stale as a share of hit+miss+stale over the last 1m.

defaults.noValue: No data: no cache results in the last 1m

targets.expr: sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",result="stale"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_cache_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",result=~"hit|miss|stale"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)

panels.title: Origin offload %
panels.description: 1 - (all-caller origin RPS / completed external client RPS) over the last 1m, clamped to [0,1]. Client RPS includes non-cache routes and failures, excluding authenticated cache replays and explicit healthcheck() requests. Origin traffic includes refreshes and callers outside Skipper, so this is not cache hit ratio; use the unclamped fetch-to-client ratio to inspect amplification. No data when client RPS is 0.

defaults.noValue: No data: no client traffic in the last 1m

targets.expr: clamp(1 - (sum(rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",key="client.requests"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)), 0, 1)

panels.title: Origin RPS
panels.description: All-caller origin requests per second over the last 1m (mock_origin_requests_total).

defaults.noValue: No data: no origin traffic in the last 1m

targets.expr: sum(rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[1m]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1))

panels.description: Cache results (hit, miss, stale, l1_hit, l2_hit where emitted) derived from route IDs in skipper_cache_route_result_total{route, result}. This dashboard derives a family from the <family>__<variant> route-ID convention; use route labels directly or adapt the expression for other naming schemes.

defaults.noValue: No data: route-result metrics not available, or no cache traffic in the window

targets.expr: sum by (family, result) (label_replace(rate(skipper_cache_route_result_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "(.+?)__.*"))

panels.title: Refresh outcomes by route family
panels.description: Background revalidation outcomes derived from route IDs in skipper_cache_route_reval_total{route, outcome}. This dashboard derives a family from the <family>__<variant> route-ID convention; use route labels directly or adapt the expression for other naming schemes.

defaults.noValue: No data: route-revalidation metrics not available, or no refresh jobs in the window

targets.expr: sum by (family, outcome) (label_replace(rate(skipper_cache_route_reval_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "(.+?)__.*"))

panels.title: Origin latency p95 by route family
panels.description: Skipper-to-origin fetch latency p95 derived from route IDs and grouped by origin status class. This dashboard derives a family from the <family>__<variant> route-ID convention; use route labels directly or adapt the expression for other naming schemes.

defaults.noValue: No data: route-labelled origin histogram not available, or no origin fetches in the window

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (family, status_class, le) (label_replace(rate(skipper_cache_origin_duration_seconds_bucket{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1), "family", "$1", "route", "(.+?)__.*")))

panels.title: Origin fetch-to-client ratio
panels.description: All-caller origin requests divided by completed external client requests, including non-cache routes and failures but excluding authenticated cache replays and explicit healthcheck() requests. Background refreshes and callers outside Skipper contribute to the numerator. This is not cache hit ratio or per-route cache effectiveness; values may exceed 1 and expose amplification that the clamped offload panels cannot show. No data when client RPS is 0.

defaults.noValue: No data: no client traffic in the window

targets.expr: sum(rate(mock_origin_requests_total{job="mock-origin"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="mock-origin"} == 1)) / (sum(rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",key="client.requests"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1)) > 0)

panels.title: Origin fetches by dispatch path
panels.description: Cache origin fetches per second by dispatch path (requires zalando/skipper#4387). direct: force mode with a static backend, bypassing the proxy pipeline, access log and backend metrics. pipeline: self-loopback through the proxy pipeline. Includes cold misses and revalidation; no data until the dispatch label is deployed or when no origin fetches occur.

defaults.noValue: Not exercised / no samples

targets.expr: sum by (dispatch) (rate(skipper_cache_origin_duration_seconds_count{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",dispatch=~"direct|pipeline"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

panels.title: Cache-Control, capacity, evictions and warm-up (requires skipper-cache-prs build)
Cache-Control directives
panels.description: Rate of Cache-Control directives seen on responses, by cache_control directive, from skipper_cache_origin_cache_control_total{cache_control}. Requires skipper-cache-prs build with bounded metrics.

defaults.noValue: No data: skipper-cache-prs build with Cache-Control counter not running, or no traffic in the window

targets.expr: sum by (cache_control) (rate(skipper_cache_origin_cache_control_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

panels.title: Cache entries
panels.description: Entries held by the cache per instance, from skipper_cache_lru_entries (gauge). Max over series per instance, as with the L1 bytes panels. Requires skipper-cache-prs build with bounded metrics.

defaults.noValue: No data: skipper-cache-prs build with entries gauge not running

targets.expr: max by (instance) (skipper_cache_lru_entries{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

panels.title: Cache bytes vs capacity
panels.description: Bytes held by the cache per instance, from skipper_cache_lru_bytes (gauge), against the configured L1 (LRU) limit from skipper_cache_lru_capacity_bytes (gauge, legend "capacity"). Max over series per instance, as with the L1 bytes panels. Requires skipper-cache-prs build with bounded metrics.

defaults.noValue: No data: skipper-cache-prs build with bytes gauge not running

targets.expr: max by (instance) (skipper_cache_lru_bytes{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
max by (instance) (skipper_cache_lru_capacity_bytes{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

panels.title: Cache evictions
panels.description: Rate of cache evictions per instance, from skipper_custom_total{key="cache.lru_eviction"}. Pair with the entries and bytes panels to see capacity pressure. Requires skipper-cache-prs build with bounded metrics.

defaults.noValue: No data: skipper-cache-prs build with evictions counter not running, or no evictions in the window

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(skipper_custom_total{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}",key="cache.lru_eviction"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))

panels.title: Time to First Hit
panels.description:
Warm-up: how long the cache took to serve its first hit after the Skipper process started.

Math: skipper_cache_first_hit_seconds = timestamp of first cache hit − timestamp of metrics init (seconds). It reads 0 until the first hit.

Shown: max per instance. Absent means no data in the selected window. Requires skipper-cache-prs build.

defaults.noValue: No data: no warm-up recorded (skipper-cache-prs build not running, or no warm-up in the window)

targets.expr: max by (instance) (skipper_cache_first_hit_seconds{job="skipper-local",instance=~"${instance:regex}"} and on (run_id, instance) (up{job="skipper-local"} == 1))
